steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Something's not right.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What is it this time? Is your illness acting up?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: This is totally different from Chernobog.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Even though our losses were significant, when we seized victory in Chernobog, we could see our enemies struggling and their accomplices fleeing for their lives.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: But doesn't Lungmen feel like it's empty?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: It can't be, right?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Come to think of it, this is supposed to be Paci Plaza, right? How come such a large mall with so many shops is completely empty?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Plus, I took a look around, and there's nothing of value lying around! Everything's already been taken!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Didn't Patriot prohibit that...

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: That's not what I was saying. You know, Mephisto doesn't care what we do, but that's not the point.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: What I was going to say is that, it's like someone hid everything from us.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: That's just your imagination. Lungmen can't do a thing against us!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We suddenly appear from every nook and cranny all of a sudden, and hot damn, it'll be just like that time at Chernobog.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: This time, we're not going to wreak havoc across the city, but take it over. It'll become our city!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Did you know?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Know what?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Paci Plaza is the closest base to the L.G.D. Headquarters. It'll be quick and convenient to supply it from here.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: I heard it when it was mentioned in the last briefing. Anything else?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: All the Reunion forces around the city are to gather at the L.G.D. Headquarters, and then spread out to take over the entire city.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: We know how the squads in this district have been deployed...

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: But what about the other districts? I know many squads are supposed to be making their way over here, but quite a few of them have gone missing without a trace.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Missing... what do you mean by that?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: It's really strange. Their comms were still connected, but there was no response from them. We don't have any way of contacting them.
And soon, no one will be able to contact you either.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: What! Who's there?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: From the window! They're outside the window!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Enemies! We're under attack by enemies! The L.G.D.... It's the L.G.D.!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah! You'd better believe it!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Damn it! Did she swing down from the roof and smash the windows?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Fight! Get moving! We have them outnumbered - all we have to do is slaughter them!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Pass me the radio.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Yes ma'am!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Listen up, L.G.D.! Pulverize Reunion along with their bunkers!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What the hell? ! Paci Plaza is my family's property! How dare you—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry, li'l Miss, Reunion is still fighting back. We'll have to prioritize neutralizing them before we can think about...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What did you say?! You good for nothing—!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D.! Attack!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Good grief... *sigh*...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Try to be careful though. These are our peoples' assets after all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They didn't move that piano away, probably because it's too heavy. That alone is worth 1.8 million LMD. The li'l Miss was boasting to me about it, so try to be careful.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: You won't get away!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Take cover! Quick! Hide behind that piano!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oops.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They smashed through our cover! Relocate!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: 1.8 million gone... just like that.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Comrades, comrades! Listen closely!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We've taken the Paci Plaza as our new base, and have set up our defenses. However, the L.G.D. suddenly attacked us from the roof! They're currently thinning out our ranks!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Alert!! L.G.D.'s main force is in Paci Plaza! I repeat, Paci Plaza!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you done yet?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: When did you—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you've finished reporting, your mission is done.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The mission is to let all the Reunion forces in Lungmen know that we are here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll be waiting for them, for them to chase after us and meet the L.G.D. in mortal combat.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: L.G.D.! Continue firing! Don't stop!
